notes: The C++ submissions are RTE and TLE, so there is no accepted reference. orig.cpp is a corpus-written nonogram solver (exact line solving by DP, propagation, probing of open cells, then backtracking); any grid matching the clues is accepted (checker.py), and it was checked with checker.py on the statement samples and 500 random grids up to 32 x 32 (slowest 3.7 s).
